head: fc04d275da7e64ed0a08d780a038bc677965652a
summary: Third dependency-ordered slice: the room shell (App.tsx, FixtureControls.tsx, main.tsx) wired onto @agora/web-framework and the Host adapter, completing the apps/web build surface (index.html, vite.config.ts, vitest.config.ts, fixture.css, full package.json). App.tsx's three component-local React effects/timers moved into new named packages/web-framework hooks (useDelayedAnnouncement, useDeferredFocus, useFocusRequestEffect) with no behavior change; both timer hooks and main.tsx's DOM mount route through a new EnvironmentPort.defer port method and getMountRoot Host function respectively, so every real timer/DOM call stays inside apps/web/src/host. Full pnpm check green (33 files, 204 tests); pnpm web:test passes (2 files, 3 tests); pnpm web:build produces 125.85 KB gzip, under R18's 350 KiB budget.
